key_insight: Dogs Trust ranks for Staffy buying and price searches on charity authority, not on a Staffy sales page: its 107-URL map holds Staffordshire Bull Terrier adoption adverts and a sponsor page but no Staffy breed guide, and its fetched pages price no dog and carry only an NGO schema. BSUK can meet those searches with a Staffy-specific guide that answers the welfare and costs questions an adopter-minded buyer brings from Dogs Trust, backed by breed schema and real litter prices.
